review.title: Arsenic coculture: Chelatococcus reference correspondence with tracer and stock limits preserved
review.independence_basis: The source preparation received independent review against the whole canonical record, complete retained primary abstract and batch120. The executing agent reread those inputs and actual native results. Root independently read the full actual M5 candidate, all32 stage inputs, application receipt and gate/history configuration before execution. This is a partial technical self-review, not a complete new scientific assessment.
review.summary: The existing NCBITaxon:3034027 descriptor now has the native exact-ID Chelatococcus_A sambhunathii reference block with total_genomes1 and majority_fraction1.0. One block/status and two native events changed. Both experimental stocks, the unselected Thermoleptolyngbya null/UNRESOLVED descriptor, source quotations, ordinal abundance, two pairwise nodes, zero arrows, two OPEN discussions and old history remain unchanged. Eight actual native checks and one append-only sidecar bind the applied bytes.
review.scope_description: Only taxonomy[1] GTDB block/status, actual application and appended history, and eight scoped native checks. Reference placement does not identify the experimental genome, resolve cultivation conditions or extend traced carbon transfer to oxygen or nitrogen.
review.selection: CommunityMech:000454 is the last single whole-record unit of the prepared four-record lane, after independently reviewed and published492,359,497 checkpoints. This diagnostic covers only454; full input capture and strict historical admission remain required before its checkpoint publication.
limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Native checks do not establish full scientific review, measured snippet validation, current generated products, aggregate QC or campaign completion.

Coverage is the complete retained PMID42468699 abstract, whole canonical record and historical batch120/C8S5 source context. No new full article, supplementary materials, original NanoSIMS image, raw isotope measurement, experimental assembly or complete cultivation recipe was audited. Historical access limitations are not a fresh exhaustive claim of absence.

The exact NCBI3034027 route supplies total_genomes1 and majority_fraction1.0 without an explicit support_genomes numerator. It is not a measured replicate count, abundance fraction or independently verified XZ-Ab1 genome. GTDB Chelatococcus_A sambhunathii is reference correspondence, not a formal species identification asserted by the primary abstract.

Preserve Chelatococcus sp. XZ-Ab1 and the quoted source identity Thermoleptolyngbya sichuanensis XZ-Cy5. The unselected NCBI3031812 descriptor retains its native null/UNRESOLVED state. Missing crosswalk correspondence neither proves organism absence nor negates the positive carbon-tracer or reciprocal-growth results.

Both DOMINANT abundance labels retain ordinal co-equal prominence, not measured percentages or a biomass ratio. Both stocks, two pairwise ecological nodes, zero downstream arrows, descriptions, evidence and two OPEN knowledge gaps remain unchanged.

The abstract reports direct photoautotroph-derived carbon transfer after13CO2 NanoSIMS tracing. Preserve that result without naming an exchanged molecule, tracing nitrogen, or claiming demonstrated cyanobacterial oxygen supply. Supplemented heterotroph monoculture and genomic interpretation are distinct from route-specific coculture measurements.

The5mM arsenite exposure refers to growing cyanobacterial monoculture, not an established coculture concentration series. Exact medium, temperature, light, inoculum densities and time points remain unresolved in the retained culture-conditions discussion.

Closed issues1931 and2514 document earlier graph and abundance repairs, respectively. Their closure does not close the two current scientific discussions or certify this new mapping. Actual issue snapshots remain captured source inputs.

Actual staging, application and all eight native commands ran at frozen M5 bfef6b2a7684bfc4bb4a22fb1b1234faf797536b with Python3.13.2. Eight free plans preceded eight serial actual gates. The CLI visited two descriptors but the native status event records one changed entry; the unselected descriptor stayed exact.

Crosswalk761 identifies bytes with an unestablished release. NCBI authority provenance is file identity/stat rather than a full database digest. Preserve batch120's original bc09-to-C8S5a16d chain, its supersedes_review assertions, the independent106 C14S5 chain and all other current biological predicates. Full checkpoints precede caller changes.
